description: Shared text-fitting fixtures (Feature 007 FR-004: shrink in shrink_step_pt steps to min_scale of the specified size, then truncate with ellipsis). Cases use the deterministic test measurement model: characters per line = max(1, floor(box_w / (font_size * 0.5))), lines = ceil(strlen / chars_per_line), rendered height = lines * font_size * line_height. Both the PHP tests and the JS canvas tests run these cases against their fitting implementations with this same model.

cases.name: shrinks_to_fit
cases.note: 16pt..13.5pt all wrap to 3 lines (> 40); 13pt: cpl=30 -> 2 lines -> 31.2 <= 40

cases.name: hits_floor_and_truncates
cases.note: floor = 20*0.6 = 12pt; at 12pt cpl=floor(100/6)=16, max_lines=floor(20/12)=1 -> 16 chars kept + ellipsis
